summary: MoneyHero Limited filed a Form 6-K disclosing receipt of a Nasdaq deficiency notice dated August 7, 2026, indicating its ordinary shares traded below US$1.00 for 30 consecutive business days, failing the minimum bid price requirement. The company has until February 3, 2027, to regain compliance by closing at or above US$1.00 for 10 consecutive business days. If not met, it may qualify for an additional 180-day period upon transfer to the Nasdaq Capital Market. The notice does not affect operations. This is a routine regulatory disclosure, not a special situation. Watch for potential reverse stock split or compliance actions.
